description: This shell script is a test suite for verifying the behavior of 'git ls-files --others' and related options in the Git version control system. It sets up various filesystem scenarios, runs Git commands, and compares the output against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with a specified name and commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or variables for equality, used to verify test outcomes.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be executed after the test completes.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for necessary prerequisites (e.g., symlink support) before running specific tests.
